post.summary: Stage a CSV, XLSX or BIFF8 XLS for mapping
post.description: Authenticated/CSRF-protected before buffering. Exactly one file field, no additional fields. Maximum 5 MiB, 5,000 total data rows, 50 columns, 10 worksheets. CSV must be UTF-8 and comma-delimited. Original bytes are not persisted. No contacts are saved. Suggested mapping uses unambiguous aliases; null email requires manual mapping. Ten upload attempts/hour, five pending imports/owner.
